The Mysterious Carrot]]'' }} |} '''Cara Liss''' (Japanese: '''ウカッツ''' ''Ukattsu'') is a mysterious researcher in the [[Galar]] [[region]]. She acts as the [[fossil]] reviver in {{g|Sword and Shield}}. ==In the core series games== Cara Liss can be found on {{rt|6|Galar}} in Galar where she has a revival machine that can bring [[Fossil|Fossil Pokémon]] found in Galar back to life. Cara Liss requires two fossils to be revived at once, one of each of the head and body fossils. Because none of the fossils belong to the same creature, each revived Pokémon is an artificial hybrid created from the parts of two separate creatures. ===Pokémon created=== * {{p|Dracozolt}} ([[Fossilized Bird]] + [[Fossilized Drake]]) * {{p|Arctozolt}} ([[Fossilized Bird]] + [[Fossilized Dino]]) * {{p|Dracovish}} ([[Fossilized Fish]] + [[Fossilized Drake]]) * {{p|Arctovish}} ([[Fossilized Fish]] + [[Fossilized Dino]]) ==Quotes== {{main|Cara Liss/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Cara Liss anime.png|thumb|250px|Cara Liss in {{aniseries|JN}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== Cara Liss appeared in ''[[JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!]]'', when {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]] met her and her research partner [[Bray Zenn]] in the [[Wild Area]]. The group dug up some fossils together, which were intended to be restored into a {{p|Dracozolt}} and {{p|Arctovish}}. However, Cara Liss and Bray Zenn mixed up their Fossilized Drake and Fossilized Dino, thus creating a {{AP|Dracovish}} and an {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Arctozolt}} instead. After getting a satisfactory amount of data out of the two Fossil Pokémon, the two researchers let Ash and Goh take the revived Pokémon with them. ====Pokémon==== =====Restored===== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Ash |pkmn=Dracovish |stage1=Fossilized Drake and Fossilized Fish |type1=Water |type2=Dragon |img=Fossilized {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Drake|1=Fish}} anime.png |cap=Fossilized {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Drake|1=Fish}} |img2=Ash Dracovish.png |epnum=JN050 |epname=A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That! |vajp=Kenyu Horiuchi |vaen=Sean Schemmel |desc=Cara Liss restored {{p|Dracovish}} by fusing together the [[Fossilized Drake]] and [[Fossilized Fish]], although she originally intended to restore {{p|Arctovish}}. After seeing how Dracovish came to like {{Ash}}, Cara Liss allowed him to capture it.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable |color={{rock color light}} |bordercolor={{rock color dark}} |ja=村川 梨衣 ''Rie Murakawa'' |en=Amanda Winn-Lee |ar= سهير ناصر الدين ''Souhair Naser El Dine'' |ca=Yolanda Gispert |fr_eu=Ioanna Gkizas |he=סיון תם ''Sivan Tam'' |id=Diah Sekartadji Wulandari |it=Annalisa Longo |pl=Karolina Bacia |pt_br=Larissa de Barros |es_eu=Chelo Vivares }} ==In the manga== [[File:Cara Liss Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Cara Liss in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Cara Liss debuted in ''[[PASS38|Munch Munch!! The Mysterious Carrot]]''. She first appeared waking up an unconscious [[Marnie]] at {{rt|6|Galar}}, having saved the latter from a {{rf|Galarian}} {{p|Zapdos}}. As compensation for being saved, Marnie was forced to assist Cara Liss with her [[fossil]] research. With some fossils they excavated, Cara Liss used her restoration machine to create an {{p|Arctovish}} and a {{p|Dracozolt}}. Their work was interrupted when the skies suddenly turned black, a sign that the [[Darkest Day]] had returned. In ''[[PASS40|Rumble!! The Darkest Day Returns]]'', Marnie decided to assist her friends stop the Darkest Day and promised to repay her debt another time. Confident that Marnie would willingly return and give up being a {{pkmn|Trainer}} to become a researcher, Cara Liss stated the debt had been repaid. Marnie immediately refuted these claims and ran off, much to Cara Liss's disappointment. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |width=75 |trainer=Marnie |pkmn=Arctozolt |img=Cara Liss Arctozolt Adventures.png |img_size=120px |type1=Electric |type2=Ice |epnum=PASS38 |epname=Munch Munch!! It was later put in [[Macro Cosmos]]'s custody, which eventually led to it joining [[Marvin]]'s [[party]].}} ==In the TCG== [[File:CaraLissShiningFates67.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Cara Liss]] {{main|Cara Liss (Vivid Voltage 149)}} '''Cara Liss''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] as one of the {{TCG|S-P Promotional cards}}, with artwork by [[Hitoshi Ariga]], available in promotional packs awarded to Japanese participants of Pokémon Card Gym tournaments starting July 2020. It later debuted in English in the {{TCG|Vivid Voltage}} expansion. Cara Liss allows the player to search their deck for up to two {{TCG ID|Darkness Ablaze|Rare Fossil|167}} cards and put them on their bench. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Cara Liss and the hybrid Pokémon she creates from fossils may be based on early paleontologists who would combine mismatched bones to produce new "discoveries", such as in the {{wp|Bone Wars}}. She could be a reference to {{wp|Richard Owen}}'s 1854 sculpture dubbed the "{{wp|Crystal Palace Dinosaurs}}," which have since been abundantly discredited, particularly the infamous interpretation of the ''{{wp|Iguanodon}}''. * In {{aniseries|JN}}, it is suggested that the [[Pokédex entry|Pokédex entries]] for the four Pokémon Cara Liss can create are made up by her and others based on their theories of what the species were capable of. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{rock color}}; border:3px solid #{{rock color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{rock color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{rock color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{rock color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ウカッツ ''Ukattsu'' | From 迂闊 ''ukatsu'' (careless) |- | English, Latin American Spanish,
